title: Portugal wins the European Championship
summary: Portugal beat France 1-0 after extra time in the final of the European Championship at the Stade de France on 10 July 2016, the country's first win in a major international competition. It is in this atlas as an event of the period and nothing more: no edge leaves it or reaches it, because no consequence could be argued for it from a source rather than from the mood of the summer.
